bugs.error_message: Postgres nonce cache accepted signed requests when nonce storage failed
bugs.root_cause: PostgreSQL nonce-store errors were not represented as an explicit replay-protection-unavailable condition, so the app-credential guard could not reliably fail closed
bugs.fix: Map nonce-store failures to NonceStorageUnavailableError, return 503 before route handlers run, and add safe structured replay-store-unavailable logging plus tests

bugs.error_message: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'scrypt') — 4 backend tests fail
bugs.root_cause: Uncommitted change uses crypto.promises.scrypt, which does not exist in Node 22
bugs.fix: Use util.promisify(crypto.scrypt) as scryptAsync in derivePasswordHashAsync

bugs.error_message: Auth rate limit keyed only by identifier allowed remote account lockout and unlimited cross-identifier stuffing; limiter buckets never pruned
bugs.root_cause: buildAuthRateLimitKey used identifier alone; InMemoryRateLimiter.prune was never called
bugs.fix: Added shared per-IP authIpLimiter (AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_IP) before per ip|identifier limiter; amortized prune in check(); TRUST_PROXY config

bugs.error_message: deployment-guide migrate command ran through pgbouncer (transaction pooling) while migrations take a session-level pg_advisory_lock
bugs.root_cause: DATABASE_URL points at pgbouncer in transaction mode; session advisory locks are not safe there
bugs.fix: Documented running migrate with DATABASE_URL direct to postgres:5432 (deploy.md, deployment-guide.md, troubleshooting stuck lock)

bugs.error_message: backup.sh left .partial dump file when pg_dump failed
bugs.root_cause: set -e exit without cleanup
bugs.fix: trap ERR removes $dump.partial; explicit rm on verification failure

bugs.error_message: OPEN RISK: app credential failures return 400 and mobile drops queued sync events on 400 (clock skew >300s loses unsynced study history)
bugs.root_cause: appCredentialGuard uses badRequest(); mobile _isPermanentSyncFailure treats 400 as permanent
bugs.fix: Not fixed yet; documented in docs/ops/README.md known risks (proposal: return 401)

bugs.error_message: caddy validate: the scheme ws:// is only supported in browsers (reverse_proxy ws://mq:8883)
bugs.root_cause: Host Caddyfile replaced with new inode; single-file bind mount kept serving an older valid copy, so host copy drifted and contained invalid ws:// upstream that would break caddy on recreate
bugs.fix: Changed to reverse_proxy mq:8883 matching running config, validated in container, wrote file in place and recreated caddy

bugs.error_message: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'bcryptjs' imported from /app/bin/cli/settings-store.mjs (omniroute reset-password.mjs)
bugs.root_cause: Upstream image ships bin/reset-password.mjs without bcryptjs dependency
bugs.fix: Login with old password (container env INITIAL_PASSWORD), GET /api/auth/csrf, PATCH /api/settings {currentPassword,newPassword} with x-omniroute-csrf header

bugs.error_message: expat8 LLM calls go to dead LiteLLM 10.113.213.1:5003 (removed); LLM fetch had no timeout; passage pipelines JSON.parse fails on ```json fenced output
bugs.root_cause: LiteLLM replaced by OmniRoute on VPS; client lacked AbortSignal; passage pipelines skipped extractJson
bugs.fix: LITELLM_TIMEOUT_MS + AbortSignal.timeout on all gateway fetches; extractJson exported and used in passage segmentation/enrichment; test for timeout needs a ref'd keepAlive timer since AbortSignal.timeout is unref'd

bugs.error_message: Level B1 user receives only A1 words; pool stuck at ~320 words
bugs.root_cause: learningCards ignored user proficiency (sorted by created_at). Scheduler always generated default level A1 with empty avoidTerms -> LLM returned the same A1 words, all duplicates, inserted 0 every minute (pool min 1000 never reached).
bugs.fix: selectNewCardsByLevel (60% level/20% below/20% above, nearest fallback); per-level targets + avoidTerms sample + exponential backoff in scheduler; shared LlmRateLimiter; crawler feeds articles into pipeline.

bugs.error_message: log line had "level":"B2" instead of info
bugs.root_cause: logger meta field named `level` overrides the log level field

bugs.error_message: No articles visible in app although crawler/pipeline process them (39 processed, all private, owner NULL)
bugs.root_cause: Crawler created ownerless private articles via createArticle; worker marks non-admin articles 'processed'; listArticles only matches owner_user_id so nobody could read them
bugs.fix: Crawler uses createAdminArticle(adminUserId 'content-crawler', private) -> pending_review -> admin publish; listArticles/getArticleByIdForUser also return visibility=published AND status=published

bugs.error_message: Word Blaster stutters after playing a while
bugs.root_cause: FlameAudio.play created+released a native AudioPlayer per sound (several per answer); session notified listeners every frame rebuilding HUD/prompt; per-frame Paint/Shader/TextPainter allocations (backgrounds, meteors, tick icon, power-up icon, particles) -> GC churn
bugs.fix: AudioPool per sound (preloaded, disposed when leaving hub); session notifies only on UI-visible state change; meteor body and static backdrop recorded to Pictures; reused Paints; cached icon painters; dispose TextPainters/Pictures onRemove

bugs.error_message: Flaky: learning_session_controller_test 'study level override...' (a1_word vs b2_word) and order-dependent controller tests
bugs.root_cause: Shown new words are marked learning asynchronously (markWordAsLearning), so returning to a level found no new word and fell back to randomNotMasteredWord; plus new-word pick became random (80/20) so newest-first expectations broke
bugs.fix: Test expects a fresh word of the chosen level (2 words per level); WordRepository gained injectable Random + shuffleNewWords flag (tests of other flows use false); word_repository_test covers both 80% and 20% branches deterministically

bugs.error_message: Games still lag after a few minutes (v1.3.8/1.4.0)
bugs.root_cause: pruneLogs every 5 min loaded all log rows and removed one per transaction on the UI isolate; one ObjectBox put per log line; large JSON decoded on UI isolate; 3-min sync/top-up ran mid-game
bugs.fix: Native query+bulk remove in Store.runAsync worker; buffered logs via putManyAsync; addBatch/addWorkplaceSentenceBatch in runAsync worker; Isolate.run JSON decode for bodies >16KB; GameActivity skips periodic work during a round

bugs.error_message: Two app instances could be opened
bugs.root_cause: launchMode singleTop + taskAffinity="" let launcher/installer 'Open' start a new task and a second Flutter engine (ObjectBox opened twice)
bugs.fix: launchMode singleTask, default task affinity; no DB attach fallback (user rejected)

bugs.error_message: Words rated easy never came back for review (56% of ratings)
bugs.root_cause: Mobile deleted easy-rated words locally; backend set next_review_at=null for easy/too_easy. Fixed-interval rules differed between mobile (3/7 days) and backend.
bugs.fix: Shared SM-2 scheduler (backend/src/domain/srs.js + mobile/lib/src/srs/srs_scheduler.dart) pinned by contracts/srs_vectors.json; every rating schedules a review; no deletion.

bugs.error_message: Late offline study events overwrote newer word state
bugs.root_cause: #upsertWordState copied the state of whichever event arrived last.
bugs.fix: State is replayed from all of the owner's events for the word in occurred_at order (replaySrsState).

bugs.error_message: Refetched card reset the word's learning schedule
bugs.root_cause: upsertWord rebuilt the entity from the incoming VocabularyWord (status/nextReview/srs defaults) — server re-sends due review cards.
bugs.fix: upsertWord keeps status, lastSeen, nextReview and SRS memory of an existing word; only content updates. Regression test added.

bugs.error_message: Family device: one member's offline events uploaded under another member's account; schedules mixed
bugs.root_cause: StudyEventEntity had no owner; sync used whoever was signed in. Local schedule was device-wide.
bugs.fix: Events stamped with ownerUserId (queue payload owner_user_id stripped before upload); dueSyncEntries skips other owners; rebuildScheduleForOwner on sign-in/out replays the owner's events; pull from GET /v1/review/states.

bugs.error_message: Level window counted events by arrival time; one offline batch could drop two levels
bugs.root_cause: Events of one sync batch share the same received_at millisecond.
bugs.fix: user_proficiency.level_changed_at = occurred_at of the triggering event; miss window counts events occurring after it.

bugs.error_message: Schedule upgrade/sign-in rebuild would wipe a signed-in learner's schedule and progress counts
bugs.root_cause: Legacy events have ownerUserId null, so replaying only the current owner's events replayed nothing; rebuild also cleared learningState (progress totals).
bugs.fix: claimUnownedEvents(userId) before every signed-in rebuild (also stamps queue payloads); rebuild resets only status/nextReview/SRS. Regression test in test/srs/family_sync_test.dart.

bugs.error_message: FITB vs plain card re-rolled on every rebuild
bugs.root_cause: shouldShowFitb drew a random number inside build().
bugs.fix: Exercise chosen once in the controller when the card is shown (currentExercise); FitbCard removed.

bugs.error_message: Review exercise could be rated twice via swipe/action bar after answering
bugs.root_cause: Gesture surface and StudyActionBar stayed enabled during exercises.
bugs.fix: Disabled while currentExercise != null; widget test learning_screen_review_test.dart.
